_comment: Template of the Mongo `system_config` document (plan §6/§4.9/§4.10). This file is version-controlled documentation only — it is never loaded directly by the app. At runtime ConfigService reads the real document from the `system_config` collection, falling back to env vars then `.env` defaults per docs/reference/configuration.md. Never put real secret values in this file or in the real Mongo document — reference an env var / secret manager instead.
